scope.budget_kind: task admission, not node cgroup hard limit

interpretation.HC_clock: One inclusive aggregate includes guard scan, shard wave, merge, bgzip, tabix and complete indexed readback. Guard compilation follows the measured per-case inside-API clock or the once-per-arm external shared-asset clock; unknown cost remains null.
interpretation.stage_clocks: Resource observation and artifact hashing are inside stage wall. Six HC child stages are explanatory only and are excluded from the effective-stage sum.
interpretation.concurrency: Four case API walls are paired values; neither their sum nor their median replaces actual concurrent batch wall. The old combined two-arm outer is not a per-arm clock.
interpretation.audit_clocks: Precision and the combined resource/heap analysis are two outside-API jobs. Their walls are separate; potentially concurrent audit walls are never added to scientific API or batch wall.
interpretation.causal_scope: One ordered four-case run per version on shared hardware. Incremental contrasts describe observed route differences, not isolated patch effects.
interpretation.biological_scope: Real read prefixes with whole-reference calling; no complete original sequencing-depth, annotation, association, or biological-truth claim.
interpretation.heap_gap: Failed earlier heap observer and later supplement do not reconstruct the missing HC heap window; no automatic leak-free claim.
interpretation.prepared_asset_scope: API and concurrent-body ratios are prepared-asset runtime comparisons. Cold/setup-inclusive speed stays null until all once-per-arm preparation costs are measured.

interpretation.arm_attribution: Original32 to prior31 includes three source patches/reference reuse plus mature parallel BQSR/shared QC/exit fix. Final66 versus prior31 adds whole-contig original HC scheduling and strict resource lifecycle.
interpretation.nested_clock_rule: HC aggregate is counted once; six child clocks and individual concurrent JVM walls are not added. API/whole-child/batch/outer and outside-API audit walls remain separate.
interpretation.failure_history_rule: First failed audit and last successful audit remain separate. No addition of potentially nested/parallel walls to infer a user total.
interpretation.resource_scope: Known sampled budgets had no observed exceedance. Unknown cycles, HC late-time PSS increases, failed earlier heap observer and missing early HC heap window remain explicit; no long-term platform or leak-free claim.
interpretation.precision_scope: Same-input full field/sequence/axis/order agreement is distinct from biological truth, full-depth WGS, annotation or association precision.
